blocking_findings.risk: An unbounded report or legacy blob can exhaust memory before validation completes.
blocking_findings.minimal_fix: Apply one shared raw-byte cap before JSON parsing or legacy adoption.
blocking_findings.test: Reject a report above the byte cap with a stable typed error.

blocking_findings.risk: Arbitrarily deep nested structures can raise RecursionError instead of a schema error.
blocking_findings.minimal_fix: Apply a deterministic maximum nesting depth before semantic validation.
blocking_findings.test: Reject depth above the limit without an unhandled exception.

blocking_findings.risk: Repeated full-payload walks add memory and runtime without audit value.
blocking_findings.minimal_fix: Keep validation bounded and profile before replacing stdlib canonical JSON.
blocking_findings.test: Use a synthetic bounded-size regression test after the strict parser exists.

blocking_findings.risk: Batch adoption can retain every raw V1 blob and scale memory with backlog size.
blocking_findings.minimal_fix: Adopt one byte-capped V1 report at a time and release it before the next.
blocking_findings.test: Large synthetic adoption remains bounded by one blob rather than total backlog size.

non_blocking_findings.risk: Caching a hash by mutable object identity can return a stale result.

recommended_next_three_tests: Reject excessive nesting with a typed schema error.
Reject raw report bytes over the configured cap.
Confirm the strict parser and canonical hash agree on a golden fixture.
avoid_building: A custom canonical JSON serializer before profiling.
Parallel hashing or a generic streaming JSON parser.
